title: ContractCommon
description: Common APXM contract envelope primitives for ids, refs, digests, typed errors, and idempotency keys.

ProviderScopedId.description: A provider-namespaced identifier minted by exactly one signed provider contribution under the reserved apxm.integration.<provider>.<name...>.v<major> namespace. The <provider> segment is a free contribution-chosen label, never a contracts-registered enum, so the value space stays open across contributions while each contribution's own descriptor closes its finite set.

ProviderScopedSchemaId.description: Provider-scoped schema id for a closed payload/descriptor schema published by one signed provider contribution. Same namespace as ProviderScopedId; contracts never owns or enumerates these ids.

ProviderScopedKindId.description: Provider-scoped closed event/action discriminant id published by one signed provider contribution. Open provider event/action strings are not canonical; the finite set is closed by the contribution descriptor, not by this generic primitive.

Base64CanonicalBytes.description: Base64 encoding of the exact canonical-JSON (utf8, sorted keys, no ambient inputs) byte serialization of one typed provider payload object. The generic envelope treats these bytes as opaque; their shape is fixed only by the exact provider-scoped payload schema and digest they are carried with, so this is not an arbitrary-JSON escape hatch.

ProviderScopedSchemaDigestRef.description: Exact reference to one provider-scoped payload/descriptor schema: the owning provider label, the provider-scoped schema id, and the sha256 of that schema's exact bytes. provider must equal the <provider> segment of schema_id.

CanonicalTypedPayload.description: One typed provider payload carried as canonical bytes bound to its exact provider-scoped schema. payload_digest is the sha256 of the base64-decoded canonical_bytes; payload_schema pins the exact provider schema id and digest that decode and validate those bytes. Carries no free-form object and no untyped fields.

ProviderContributionRef.description: Signed-contribution identity that binds one generic envelope instance to exactly one provider contribution by descriptor digest and ed25519 signature. provider is the free contribution-chosen label, not a contracts enum; every provider-scoped id in the same envelope must share this provider segment.
